metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.2 · 2017 · The Outlaws
metas.description: Based on real events, this crime action film depicts a Seoul detective's attempts to keep peace while two Chinese-Korean gangs battle over turf in the neighborhood.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.0 · 2022 · The Roundup
metas.description: Followed by Ma Seok-do, who heads to a foreign country to extradite a suspect. However, he discovers additional murder cases and learns about a killer who had committed crimes against tourists for many years.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.6 · 2023 · The Roundup: No Way Out
metas.description: Seven years after the roundup in Vietnam, Ma Seok-do joins a new squad to investigate a murder case. He soon starts to dig deeper when he finds out the case involves a synthetic drug and a gang of thugs.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.6 · 2024 · The Roundup: Punishment
metas.description: Detective Ma Seok-do joins the Cyber Investigation Team to nab Baek Chang-ki, a former mercenary and the head of an online gambling organization.
